request.style: English, solo female country voice, warm and earnest, acoustic guitar, piano, fiddle, steady 90 BPM, mood of urgent hope and praise
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
God come and rescue me
Lord hurry to my help
Let those who seek my life
Be shamed and humbled back

[Pre-Chorus]
Let those who delight in ruin
Be driven back in shame
Let those who say aha
Be turned by their disgrace

[Chorus]
But let all who seek you rejoice
Be glad in you always
Let those who love your salvation
Say let God be magnified

[Verse]
I am poor and I am needy
God hurry to my side
You are my help and deliverer
My strength and my guide

[Chorus]
But let all who seek you rejoice
Be glad in you always
Let those who love your salvation
Say let God be magnified

[Bridge]
LORD do not delay
Your hand is my stay
You are my help and my light
In the day of my fight

[Chorus]
But let all who seek you rejoice
Be glad in you always
Let those who love your salvation
Say let God be magnified

[Outro]
Let God be magnified
Let God be magnified
